headline: Wall Street Launches Wave of Thematic ETFs to Capture AI and Space Boom
summary: Fund managers are accelerating the rollout of thematic exchange-traded funds targeting robotics and the space economy to satisfy investor appetite following the artificial intelligence market rally.
why: Thematic ETF launches reflect asset manager fee-generation strategies and indicate retail and institutional capital allocation trends across emerging tech sectors.

impacts.name: Asset Management
impacts.why: Proliferation of thematic investment products drives higher management fees and fund inflows.
